g_policy.reason: The user opts in by tapping the card. The offer copy states the reward ('3 answers in Advanced reasoning mode today'). The decline path ('Not now') leaves home unchanged, and the ad-fail path is covered.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers until midnight, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3 or more days with no session, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes'). It adds a sample of a paid feature and no new cap on anything free.

g_brand_safety.reason: The offer is a dismissible card in the app chrome of s01 Chats (home), which is rated safe. It is not inside a conversation or over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As an existing_anchor, it rewards 'Advanced reasoning mode', which the paywall (s02.e03, l02) shows the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: The offer copy says 'All your past chats will be lost in 30 days if you do not upgrade to Luzia+'. This is a claim about current app behavior, and no mechanic or element in the product model supports it.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The 'subscribers' field says Luzia+ members never see the card, and the card sits on the home screen, which is not a paid-only area.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 3 answers that expire at midnight local time. It is a sample that ends, and it does not give away the main benefit unlimited.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears on the home screen at app open, before the user starts a task, and it is dismissible, so it interrupts nothing.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The reward is granted only on a confirmed play ('If the play isn't confirmed... try again'), and the trigger is a detectable session gap.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Advanced reasoning mode paywall item (s02.e03), the Luzia+ badge (s01.e02) and the Chats home layout, so it would not read the same in any app.

other_concern: The copy threatens the loss of past chats, which is unsupported and could mislead users, and it may work as a scare tactic aimed at subscriptions. Whether the app tracks a 3-day session gap is not established in the model. The reward is explicitly labeled an inference.
